name: testrace
description: Telegram test-musobaqa boti: PDF/Word/matndan test shablonlari + guruhda musobaqa rejimi

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @testrace/server" "npm run dev -w @testrace/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @testrace/shared && npm run build -w @testrace/server && npm run build -w @testrace/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @testrace/web
scripts.test: npm run smoke -w @testrace/server && npm run smoke:race -w @testrace/server
